_doc: Data-plane threat register (BI-PF-1296 / EDP-04). Machine-readable, versioned map of the six EDP data-plane threat categories -> source -> sink -> data flows -> control -> owner -> evidence. Validated by scripts/dev/data_plane_threat_check.py (precheck gate 'data-plane-threats'); every finding cites the ADR ledger (ADR-0006, BI-PF-1293). status: implemented | partial | planned; evidence resolves to a repo path, 'gate:<name>' or 'item:<BI-PF-id>'.

threats.title: Cross-tenant IDOR (a tenant reads/writes another tenant's record or object)
threats.sink: tenant-B data (DB row or stored object)
flows: HTTP request -> api routers -> store read/write
threats.control: authorization at the boundary + per-tenant row scoping (RLS USING/WITH CHECK)

threats.title: Path traversal / symlink escape in local object storage
threats.control: root containment + symlink defense + key normalization + size limits

threats.title: Token / role spoofing (forged bearer token, client-supplied roles)
threats.control: fail-closed Bearer auth; roles derive from the token, not the client

threats.title: Object-URL leakage (guarded/predictable keys or over-long signed URLs)
threats.sink: unauthorized reader of an object payload
flows: artifact metadata -> signed URL -> object store
threats.control: authz-gated metadata + scoped, short-lived signed URLs

threats.title: Uncontrolled egress (data leaving the tenant's allowed region/network)
threats.sink: external endpoint outside the allowed regions

threats.title: Residency bypass (data stored/processed outside the tenant home region)
threats.sink: region cell that is not the tenant home region
